note: Convenience only. Detection is fully automatic (see docs/DETECTION.md) - these entries just help users find an executable. No profile paths or URL schemes are stored; both are derived at run time.
hintNote: Hints are directories to look for exeName in. A '*' segment matches one directory level. Landing on a launcher stub is not fatal - LauncherStub.Resolve redirects Squirrel stubs to the real app-<version> executable - but a hint that points at the real thing saves the user a step.

apps.note: Detection and launch test verified 7 Aug 2026 against Slack 4.51.180. The root %LOCALAPPDATA%\slack\slack.exe is a Squirrel stub: it scores zero Chromium markers and fails the launch test after the full 30s, because it does not forward --user-data-dir. app-4.51.180\slack.exe scores 5 and passes in 1.4s. The versioned hint is listed first for that reason. Routing and badging are still untested, so this stays verified:false.
Not installed on any machine we have tested. Discord uses the same Squirrel layout as Slack, so the versioned hint is listed first by analogy - that is an inference, not a measurement.

Unlike Slack's stub, the root executable does forward --user-data-dir - it passed in 3.6s.
